project.name: Crabber Coworkers
project.vision: Give a person always-on AI coworkers (Dots) with their own workspace, built on the Crabber Rust runtime instead of CopilotKit/TypeScript.

comparators.name: OpenDots
comparators.relevance: The product this repository ports: persistent specialist Dots with Spaces, per-Dot computers, review-before-save, and Slack.

comparators.name: OpenBot
comparators.relevance: Shows how OpenDots gives each coworker its own persistent computer with permissioned, recorded actions.

comparators.name: OpenTag
comparators.relevance: The Slack integration pattern OpenDots follows: allowlisted workspace/user, selected specialist, in-thread replies.

comparators.name: OpenAI dots
comparators.relevance: A commercial always-on coworker reachable from ChatGPT and Slack, with its own computer and approval rules.

comparators.name: Claude Duet
comparators.relevance: A proactive agent on its own VM that drafts freely but asks before external effects.

comparators.name: Grok Bot
comparators.relevance: Multiple persistent teammates with their own computers, memory, team sharing, and group-chat handoff.

evaluation_lenses.name: Persistent identity
evaluation_lenses.question: Does a coworker keep its name, role, instructions, and history across restarts?

evaluation_lenses.name: Channel reach
evaluation_lenses.question: Can a user reach the coworker where they already work (Slack, Discord, web)?

evaluation_lenses.name: Bounded autonomy
evaluation_lenses.question: Are the coworker's tools and actions permissioned, with human approval for risky ones?

evaluation_lenses.name: Own workspace
evaluation_lenses.question: Does each coworker get an isolated, persistent workspace or computer for its files and tools?

acceptance_journey: A user mentions a coworker in Slack, it answers in-thread using its configured role, and history survives restart.
non_goals: No dependency on CopilotKit Intelligence or other hosted agent services.
Port OpenDots behavior, not its TypeScript source.

related_repositories.role: Embeddable Rust agent runtime that coworkers run on.
Buddy repo: durable Discord and Slack conversation host for Crabber.
Workspace coding tools catalog (file, search, shell, patch, fetch) for Crabber agents.
Trusted native Crabber extensions: workspace instructions, ask-user, delegated tasks, web search, command enforcement, background jobs.
Persistent agent sandboxes that could serve as each coworker's computer.
